name: artiboard
description: Project task boards for people and coding agents, with Claude Artifacts or a persistent local webserver.

interface.shortDescription: Shared project boards for people and coding agents
interface.longDescription: Manage tasks, dependencies, claims, threads and handoffs. Use Claude Artifacts when available, or a persistent Python and SQLite board on the same machine.
defaultPrompt: Use Artiboard to set up a persistent task board for this project.
Use Artiboard to find the next ready task and review its handoff.
